# Environment

```{r}
packages <- c("tidyverse","cowplot","ggtree","ape","phytools","gridExtra","kableExtra","colorRamp2","RColorBrewer","ComplexHeatmap",'phyloAMR','ggtext')

# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages,library,character.only=T,quietly=T))
source("./lib/common_functions.R")
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")
source("./scripts/GWAS/analysis/GWAS_analysis_scripts.R") 

# Set null device
set_null_device("agg")

# Print environment
set.seed(45) 
Sys.info()
sessionInfo()  
```

# Load data

```{r} 
# Standard data
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")
tr <- read.tree("./data/tree/tree.treefile")
# GWAS table
gwas_table <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/hits/gwas_hits_table.RDS") %>% subset(nn_qc=="Pass")
gwas_mat <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/hits/gwas_mat.RDS")  
# Matrices
## Kleborate matrix
kleborate <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/matrices/kleborate_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
## KPC Plasmids 
KPC_containing_clusters <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/matrices/KPC_containing_cluster_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
## BLBLI clustering
pclustering <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr_clustering_df.RDS")
blbli_asr <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr.RDS") 
# Join
df <- left_join(df,kleborate %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))  
df <- left_join(df,pclustering %>% select(isolate_no,blbli_asr_cluster_renamed))
df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed_simple <- recode(df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed,"No feature"="Susceptible" )

# KPC plasmids 
KPC_info_clusters <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid/KPC_containing_clusters_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
KPC_containing_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="KPC Plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame%>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
KPC_clusters <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters)
Non_KPC_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_non_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="Non-KPC plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame %>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))) %>% left_join(Non_KPC_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))
 
df$AA552_status_md <- ifelse(df$AA552_KPC ==1, "AA552 <i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub> plasmid",ifelse(df$AA552_non_KPC ==1,"AA552 Non-<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub> plasmid","Other")) %>% factor(.,levels = c("AA552 <i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub> plasmid","AA552 Non-<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub> plasmid","Other"))

df$AA552_status <- gsub("<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>","blaKPC",df$AA552_status_md)
   
df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed_simple <- recode(df$blbli_asr_cluster_renamed,"No feature"="Susceptible" )
``` 

# Status over time

```{r}
df$date <- lubridate::as_date(df$Cx_date) 
# Number of weeks using date data
number_of_weeks <- as.numeric(round(difftime(max(df$Cx_date),min(df$Cx_date),units = 'weeks')) + 1)
date_breaks_s13 <- c(as.Date("2014-08-01"), as.Date("2015-02-01"), as.Date("2015-07-24"))   # define once, near the top

A <- ggplot(data=df,aes(x=Cx_date,fill=AA552_status_md)) + geom_histogram(bins = number_of_weeks) + theme_bw_me + xlab("Collection date") + ylab ("Isolates") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20))  + theme_bw_me + theme(legend.position='none') + AA552_scale + s_figure_13_format +
  scale_x_date(breaks = date_breaks_s13, date_labels = "%b %Y") 

A
```

# Temporal distribution

```{r} 
df$AA552_status_md_rev <- factor(df$AA552_status_md,levels = rev(levels(df$AA552_status_md)))

B <-   ggplot(data=df,aes(x=Cx_date,fill=AA552_status_md_rev,y=AA552_status_md_rev)) + geom_boxplot(alpha=0.75,outliers=F) + geom_jitter(mapping = aes(color=as.factor(blbli_asr_cluster_renamed_simple)),alpha=1,width = 0,height = 0.25,size=0.5) + theme_bw_me + xlab("Collection date") + ylab("")   + theme(legend.position = 'none')  + theme_bw_me + theme(legend.position='none') +  AA552_scale + cluster_scale_gray_color + theme(axis.text.y = element_markdown()) + s_figure_13_format +
 scale_x_date(breaks = date_breaks_s13, date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1)))  +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" plasmid", "<br>plasmid", x))

B
```

# Heatmaps

# E. Facility plot
```{r}
agg_grab_dev <- function(width, height) ragg::agg_capture(width = width, height = height, units = "in")
df$AA552_status_rev <- factor(df$AA552_status,levels = rev(levels(factor(df$AA552_status))))
phenotype = 'AA552_status_rev'
  dataframe <- df
  dataframe$clustering <- as.factor(dataframe[[phenotype]])
  
  matrix_raw <- dataframe %>%
    group_by(LTACH_Recode, clustering) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = LTACH_Recode,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0  
    ) %>% column_to_rownames(var='clustering')

  matrix_raw_ordered <- matrix_raw[match(rev(levels(dataframe$clustering)),rownames(matrix_raw),incomparables = F) %>% subset(is.na(.)==F),]

 
   rownames(matrix_raw_ordered) <- paste0(rownames(matrix_raw_ordered)," (n = ",rowSums(matrix_raw_ordered),")") 
  mat_prop <- sweep(matrix_raw_ordered, 1, rowSums(matrix_raw_ordered), FUN = "/")   
  E_row_labels <- gsub("blaKPC", "<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>", rownames(mat_prop))      # ADDED

  max(rownames(mat_prop) %>% nchar()) 
  shared_rn_width <- unit(3, "in")
  
 fig <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(matrix = mat_prop,
    col = c("white", "red"),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
       val <- matrix_raw_ordered[i, j] 
    if (val != 0) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.2s", val), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))          # was 12
    }
    },
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_title = NULL,
    column_title_side = "bottom",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7.5),                                  # ADDED
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5),                                  # ADDED
    width = ncol(mat_prop) * unit(.25, "in"),                                # was .4
    height = nrow(mat_prop) * unit(.13, "in"),                               # was .2
    column_names_centered = TRUE,
    row_names_centered = FALSE,
    row_names_max_width = shared_rn_width,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5),
    row_labels = gt_render(E_row_labels))       
     
heatmap_for_cowplot  <-    grid.grabExpr(draw(fig)) 

fig_E <- fig
# Add margin to this
E <- cowplot::plot_grid(heatmap_for_cowplot)

E
```

# F. Spatiotemporal overall

```{r}
phenotype = 'blbli_asr_cluster_renamed_simple_rev'
  dataframe <- df
  dataframe$clustering <- as.factor(dataframe[[phenotype]])
  
  matrix_raw <- dataframe %>%
    group_by(LTACH_Recode, clustering) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = LTACH_Recode,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0  
    ) %>% column_to_rownames(var='clustering')

  matrix_raw_ordered <- matrix_raw[match(rev(levels(dataframe$clustering)),rownames(matrix_raw),incomparables = F) %>% subset(is.na(.)==F),]

  rownames(matrix_raw_ordered) <- paste0(rownames(matrix_raw_ordered)," (n = ",rowSums(matrix_raw_ordered),")")

  mat_prop <- sweep(matrix_raw_ordered, 1, rowSums(matrix_raw_ordered), FUN = "/")  
  
  fig <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(matrix = mat_prop,
    col = c("white", "red"),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
       val <- matrix_raw_ordered[i, j] 
    if (val != 0) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.2s", val), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))          # was 12
    }
    },
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_title = "Facility",
    column_title_side = "bottom",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7.5),                                  # ADDED
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5),                                  # ADDED
    width = ncol(mat_prop) * unit(.25, "in"),                                # was .4
    height = nrow(mat_prop) * unit(.13, "in"),                               # was .2
    column_names_centered = TRUE,
    row_names_centered = FALSE,
    row_names_max_width = shared_rn_width,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5))       

heatmap_for_cowplot  <-    grid.grabExpr(draw(fig)) 

# Add margin to this
f <- cowplot::plot_grid(heatmap_for_cowplot)

f
```

# Heatmap fixes
```{r}
# Widths of each heatmap's row labels
rn_w_E <- ComplexHeatmap::max_text_width(rownames(fig_E@matrix), gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5))
rn_w_F <- ComplexHeatmap::max_text_width(rownames(mat_prop),     gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5))

# Padding order: bottom, left, top, right; extra right padding on the narrower one
pad <- function(extra) unit.c(unit(2, "mm"), unit(2, "mm"), unit(2, "mm"), unit(2, "mm") + extra)

E <- cowplot::plot_grid(grid.grabExpr(draw(fig_E, padding = pad(unit.pmax(rn_w_F - rn_w_E, unit(0, "mm")))),
                                      device = agg_grab_dev))
f <- cowplot::plot_grid(grid.grabExpr(draw(fig,   padding = pad(unit.pmax(rn_w_E - rn_w_F, unit(0, "mm")))),
                                      device = agg_grab_dev))
```


# Curate figure
```{r,fig.height=9.5,fig.width=7.5}
AC <- cowplot::plot_grid(A, C, ncol = 1, labels = c("A","C"), label_size = 12,
                         align = "v", axis = "lr")
BD <- cowplot::plot_grid(B, D, ncol = 1, labels = c("B","D"), label_size = 12,
                         align = "v", axis = "lr")
ABCD <- cowplot::plot_grid(AC, BD, ncol = 2)

figure <- cowplot::plot_grid(ABCD, E, f, G, labels = c("","E","F","G"), ncol = 1, label_size = 12,
                             rel_heights = c(0.7, 0.2, 0.38, 1))   # F: 0.35 -> 0.38
figure
```
